# js-contrib

> GPU-accelerated X-SCAPE heavy-ion simulations with Python and PyTorch: install, run the productions, analyse the files, write your own modules.

js-contrib is the contrib package of the X-SCAPE (JETSCAPE) heavy-ion event generator:
MUSIC hydrodynamics on the GPU (CUDA, Apple Metal), Python bindings down to the module
level (PyJetscape), ready-made productions (Au+Au and Pb+Pb with jets and Z+jet, O+O and
Ne+Ne with initial-state radiation) that write HDF5 files, readers and analyses for those
files, and PyTorch surrogates of the hydro. It runs from a production container
(`jhputschke/xscape-prod`, Docker or Apptainer, NVIDIA GPU), a Mac wheel (`xscape`,
Apple Silicon), or a source build; the analyses need only a Python venv.

Notes for assistants: the examples and production scripts are copied into a user
directory with `xscape-examples DIR`; that copy carries an `AGENTS.md` (and a
`CLAUDE.md` importing it) with the commands per installation and the rules for running
productions. Every driver prints its options with `--help`. The analysis scripts are
examples, not vetted physics results.


## Start here

- [Home](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/index.md): what js-contrib is and where to go next
- [Choose your setup](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/install/index.md): the four setups (container, Mac wheel, analysis venv, source build) and which to choose
- [Your first event](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/run/first-event/index.md): one O+O event and two Au+Au jet events through the whole chain, per setup
- [AI assistants](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/reference/ai-assistants/index.md): using Claude Code, other coding agents and chat assistants with js-contrib

## Install

- [Production container](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/install/container/index.md): the production image, its rules (/work, --user, GPU flags), running examples and productions in it
- [Mac (xscape wheel)](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/install/mac/index.md): the xscape wheel on Apple Silicon, its commands (xscape-run, xscape-examples, ...) and limits
- [Analysis environment](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/install/analysis-env/index.md): the Python venv for reading and analysing files, with or without ROOT
- [Source build (conda)](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/install/source/index.md): building X-SCAPE contrib with js-contrib in the js_fno conda environment

## Run

- [Running the productions](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/run/index.md): what a production is, the drivers and run_jobs.sh, seeds and campaigns
- [Au+Au jets (two stages)](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/run/auau-jet/index.md): the main production, Au+Au 0-10 % with a jet in two hydro legs; run_prod_jet.py, run_jobs.sh, hadronize.py
- [O+O with ISR](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/run/oo-isr/index.md): O+O at 200 GeV with initial-state radiation; run_prod_oo_isr.py
- [Z+jet and other systems](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/run/zjet-other/index.md): Z+jet, Pb+Pb and other systems by changing the user XML
- [Extra hard scatterings, O+O and Ne+Ne](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/run/extra-hard/index.md): extra hard scatterings per event, O+O and Ne+Ne, minimum bias
- [Clusters, GPUs and monitoring](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/run/clusters/index.md): jobs per GPU, SLURM, several GPUs, jobmon, checking a run, troubleshooting
- [Data on the OSDF](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/run/osdf/index.md): downloading, reading in place and uploading productions on the OSDF with js_osdf.py

## Analyse

- [Analyse](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/analysis/index.md): environments, getting files, a first spectrum
- [What a production writes](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/analysis/files/index.md): every file a production writes, dataset by dataset, and what an event is
- [Hadrons](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/analysis/hadrons/index.md): HadronFileReader, histograms with per-event statistics, errors, pT-hat windows
- [Jets with FastJet](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/analysis/jets/index.md): jets with FastJet from Python, areas and background subtraction
- [Hydro and hadrons together](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/analysis/hydro-hadrons/index.md): the hydro pair and the hadron pair together, the jet wake
- [O+O](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/analysis/oo/index.md): analysing the O+O production
- [Bulk and flow](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/analysis/bulk/index.md): bulk observables and flow
- [ROOT and C++](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/analysis/root/index.md): the ROOT export, uproot, RDataFrame and the C++ reader
- [Notebooks](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/analysis/notebooks/index.md): index of the analysis notebooks

## Python

- [Python](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/python/index.md): overview of PyJetscape
- [The Pythonic interface](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/python/pythonic/index.md): the Pythonic interface, events in a Python loop as numpy arrays
- [Writing modules in Python](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/python/modules/index.md): writing X-SCAPE modules (energy loss, hydro, writers, ...) in Python
- [Live PyTorch FNO hydro](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/python/fno/index.md): a PyTorch FNO as live hydro module
- [FastHydro](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/python/fasthydro/index.md): the fast finite-volume hydro with the real jet energy-loss chain
- [3D visualization](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/python/visualization/index.md): 3D rendering of events with PyVista

## Python API

- [Python API](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/python/api/index.md): the API pages in the order of the site (run, write, analyse, ROOT/bulk/FNO, C++) and how to read them
- [Run events](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/python/api/run/index.md): per_event, JobDir, run_jetscape, modules in Python (@js.module), with examples
- [Write the files](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/python/api/write/index.md): HadronH5Writer for your own runs, and the production writers (particlize, hadronize, hydro pair)
- [Analyse the files](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/python/api/analyse/index.md): HadronFileReader (histograms, the wake, single events, pT-hat windows), FastJet, HadronArray and awkward, ParticlizeFile, the hydro pair, with examples
- [ROOT, bulk and FNO files](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/python/api/bulk/index.md): the ROOT bulk reader and writer, the FNO4d HDF5 schema and compression, PyFNOHydro, numpy and torch conversions
- [C++ bindings](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/python/api/core/index.md): pyjetscape_core, the C++ bindings with every class and method, and the methods the Pythonic layer adds

- [12 · Write your own in-run writer](https://jhputschke.github.io/js-contrib/tutorials/pyjetscape/12_python_writer/index.md): an in-run writer in Python
